sampling.method: sort the `a` side of every pair (equivalent + not_equivalent) by sha256(pair id) ascending; walk it, taking the first 60 that are single-obligation shall/must sentences of 6-40 words, whose text is new, and that the tuned-on check does not exclude
sampling.tuned_check: Scanned 154 committed text file(s) under src, tests, docs, claims, bench/results, bench/corpus/parity.yml, README.md, CONTEXT.md, AGENTS.md for each candidate's pair id and for any run of 8 consecutive word tokens of its text (case- and punctuation-insensitive); a hit excludes the candidate. This sees verbatim and quoted-fragment reuse in committed files only. It cannot see tuning done from a paraphrased mention, from uncommitted work or from conversation, and the corpus's own source repositories were read while the rules were developed, so 'not tuned on' cannot be established: only 'not found quoted'. The generated corpora (external-v1..v4, direction-v1, tier2-*) are not scanned: they are built from the same pinned prose and would exclude every candidate.

statements.text: The Requirements Tool shall provide a "1000-feet view" kind of requirements visualization.
All source code and development related documents shall be controlled under a version control system.
New System version releases shall be released at the beginning of each NFL season.
The system shall display detailed invoice for current order once it is confirmed.
The System shall generate Inventory Quantity Adjustment document based on product daily sales data and product formulas.
The Requirement Tool's source code shall be based on open source software components.
The Requirements Tool shall allow generating a Compliance Matrix document.
The user shall enter new ratings based on the audit report
The Requirements Tool's development process shall include the Requirements Tool's own requirements engineering.
The Requirements Tool shall support exporting documentation content to PDF, both individual documents and complete documentation trees.
The system shall notify the user of any schedule changes.
Doorstop **shall** provide a way to view requirements as a document.
The system shall have a help system that offers tips and explanation for each screen and each item on the screens upon demand.
The adjuster shall enter the preferred repair facility on the estimate assignment.
Customers must have a valid login id to enter into the site.
Doorstop **shall** associate requirements changes to existing developer identification.
Doorstop **shall** provide a lightweight installation method.

The system shall contain contact information (e-mail and phone number) for all people relevant to the system including (but not limited to) staff members students lecture instructors clinical lab instructors and clinical site administrators.
The system shall allow modification of the display.
The product shall be able to send meeting notifications via different kinds of end-user specified methods.
The Requirements Tool shall provide controls for automatic generation of requirements UIDs.
100% of the cardmember and merchant services representatives shall use the Disputes application regularly after a 2-day training course.
The System shall allow for a minimum of 6 users to work at the same time.
The system shall allow user to confirm the purchase.
Once a game is initiated the product shall display a defensive grid to each player
Doorstop **shall** be scalable to support thousands of requirements.
The Requirements Tool shall provide capabilities for validating requirements according to the EARS syntax.
The system shall allow a Program Administrator or Nursing staff member to remove a student from a clinical lab section.
The Requirements Tool shall allow management of documents with nested sections/chapters structure.
The system shall display all the matching products based on the search.
The system shall show the meetings to the user in ascending time order by default.
Doorstop **shall** provide the capability to baseline versions of requirements.
The Requirements Tool shall support the Reverse Parent relationship.
Doorstop **shall** provide a way to view document items interactively.
It must be able to download the most recent medical record.
Product shall allow entering storing and modifying product menus used by POS terminals.
The Requirements Tool shall provide a Web API interface.
The system shall allow user to enter the contact number for support personnel to call.
The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.
The Requirements Tool shall provide browsing of the documentation tree.
The product shall run on the existing hardware for all environments.
The Requirements Tool shall support requirement trees with at least 10000 requirements.
The product shall take initial load time depending on internet connection strength which also depends on the media from which the product is run.

Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members shall have the ability to modify information relating to a Clinical Lab Section including the clinical site name the department/section for the lab the class instructor day and time of lab and contact information.
The Requirements Tool shall provide identifying information, including title, release version, and project website links.
The vehicle data shall include vehicle year make and model
Doorstop **shall** be able to import content from other requirments management tools.
Once a game has been initiated the product shall make the players assigned to the game unavailable for selection from the list of players.
Responses to queries shall take no longer than 7 seconds to load onto the screen after the user submits the query.
The system shall permit only cafeteria staff members who are on the list of authorized Menu Managers to create or edit menus.
The Requirements Tool shall be usable on the normal personal computers, e.g., do not require a special cloud deployment.
The Requirements Tool shall support structuring requirements in documents.
The system shall allow user to select the financing option.
The estimator shall search for available recycled parts using a list of preferred parts suppliers.
The system shall allow user to select the product to configure.
The Requirements Tool shall provide programmatic access to requirements data.
The system shall use the SMTP mail protocol.
Only authorized users shall have access to the portion of the system that interfaces with CampusConnect.
The Requirements Tool shall be capable of supporting a large number of users.
The Requirements Tool shall support exporting/importing requirements content from/to Excel.
